title: FlightCost — production fleet economics at research base revision
retrieval_method: local checkout at the named revision
locator: DEFAULTS; NEW_GENERATION; GENERATIONS; generation; parametric; load
finding: Rent uses the generation reference multiplied by (MTOW/78)^1.10. New types use 345000 EUR/month at the 78-tonne reference; other types use 200000 EUR/month with an approximate 12-year-old-aircraft basis. Seats and segment do not enter this rent formula. Load permits explicit, stored and aircraft-card overrides.
use: independent model benchmark; age labels; precedence disclosure

title: FlightCost — production historical rent comparator
retrieval_method: local checkout at the named revision
finding: The existing type-page comparator uses fixed 1.16 USD/EUR and CPI_y/CPI_2026. Years beyond the final CPI observation use its final annual growth. This is a display normalization of a static current model, not a time-series forecast.
use: same historical display convention for the article's model lines

title: FlightCost — explicit market observation and public type defaults
retrieval_method: local checkout at the named revision
finding: The selected accepted observation becomes a scenario lease override after FX conversion at calculation date only when a manual lease was not supplied. Public type-page fleet_default instead comes from fleet.parametric. Neither is an automatically fitted lease-age curve.
use: separate independent baseline, effective calculator selection and explicit market midpoint

title: FlightCost — committed US CPI-U annual series
retrieval_method: local checkout at the named revision
finding: The committed series ends in 2025. The comparator extrapolates 2026 as 321.9 squared divided by 313.7, or 330.3143449155244. This extrapolation is exposed in the exported metadata.
use: audit the historical USD reference denominator

title: OpenAP 2.6.2 — installed public aircraft input package
retrieval_method: installed distribution metadata and 11 local aircraft YAML files; no network fetch
locator: openap/data/aircraft; package and input hashes in out/model_reference.json
finding: The production openap_aircraft parser supplies 11 study aircraft. In this exact package snapshot both A20N and B738 have MTOW 79 tonnes. Four other types use repository catalogue cards. Model output retains the input version and individual file hashes.
use: reproducible aircraft masses rather than invented aircraft-model constants
